title: CALCULUS AND PROBABILITY FOR THE LIFE SCIENCES II
description: Continuation of MTH 227 with more general population growth models. Antidifferentiation; The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus applied to solving continuous growth models. Continuous random variables. Basic linear algebra of small systems sufficient to calculate eigenvalues and eigenvectors and appreciate their use in life science applications.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MTH 227 or 227X.
A minimum grade of C- is required in MTH 227 and MTH 227X.
